essence: Glad-hearted go to the worship-place; wherever the heart is gladdened, fit for Lord-immersion: that alone is the mark; meditated-identity the cause from gladness alone.
Seats and mountains named only as gladness-aids.
Entered powers taking body, noble/barbarian lands, solitude-concentration: why places help.
General placing first on hands, then on body, outside.
Two Mālinī-alphabet mantras; Śakti first; foot-to-head for release, reversed for enjoyment.
Mālinī the chief Śākta form; seed-womb collision grants all wishes.
Name unfolded: Rudra-garlanded, fruit-flowering, winter-sound bee, attainment-release holder, giving-taking power; ra-la one.
Broken mantra completed, stained purified: her nyāsa's power.
Same nyāsa on the vessel.
Every factor made Lord through its placing; worship the example.
Seeing all factors as Lord: becoming Lord without knowledge or yoga.
Drop-sprinkling of essence and flowers.
Halo-circle retinue worship, ground or sky.
Door-deity-wheel hail.
Unguarded outside: move all inside.
Weapon-flower clearing; kindled-gaze survey.
North-facing; burnt bonds by Aghora-radiance.
Lord's freedom form-shining the direction-principle.
Middle awareness-light; quarters by light-relations; direction-four.
Bhairava faces center, above, below, quarters, betweens.
Directions awareness-glory formed; no separate principle.
Overstepping shadow reaches all-presiding centrality.
Sun = Lord's knowledge-power; east wherever manifest; self-ruled yet facing.
Self-sun-Lord triad-unification; gurus' saying.
I-feeling burnt; waveless abode; first throb-digit form; wheel-placing with powers chief.
Seat-ness and power's worthiness: gurus' reason.
Five states plus unsurpassed nature-state contemplated.
Sixfold placing sealed.
Presiding causes; transcended group; fullness = Bhairavī-being; no opening.
Objection: waveless gained, why more emission-placing?
Answer: waveless Bhairava shows variety-peak in self.
Lord-made breath-body-mind seen; worshipped outside-within.
Body-breath-mind trident-lotus: root-bulb-staff-knot-lotus-Sadāśiva-corpse.
Offering = worship; becoming = meditation; shaking = murmur; universe-self-making = oblation; retinue like sparks.
Remember the trident root to twelve-end.
Abandoning sequence attains sky-going-ness.
Sky-peak-filling from root-support.
Faring, resting, nectar-eating: sky-living.
Inner rite alone truly suffices.
Outer removes limitation and wins immersion; inner veils beasthood and purifies resolve.
Preparation list: ground, Gaṇeśa, vessels, altar, fire.
Daily: altar worship-oblation alone.
Adhivāsa: disciple sharpened, God turned, guru taking up.
In-house things, Lord-swollen, made worship-fit.
Arranged house; remembered Goddess; radiance-mass borne; handful cast.
Scattered mustard gathered north-east: ground taken.
Seat, Gaṇeśa, bliss-jar, betel, chief mantra remembered; 108-muttered jar made.
Second vessel: obstacle-weapons.
Weaponed guardians in own directions.
Disciple handed the weapon-vessel.
Guru takes the jar.
Disciple pours around; guru follows with Indra verse.
Attentive to the end, by Śiva's command.
'Bho' is one in the three-syllabled name.
Jar placed north-east.
Weapon-vessel over the scattered.
Both worshipped.
Supreme-worship at altar-middle.
Fire-pit as power; heart-fire unified; mantras sated with ghee-sesame.
Vessel-sprinkling refines.
Non-difference-view refines.
Even-footed, nectar-stream contemplated, vauṣaḍ uttered till ghee ends.
Shared caru; one share left; disciple's share given.
Tooth-stick next.
Fall there inauspicious.
Weapon-mantra oblation.
Blindfolded, kneeling, flower-cast for mantra-fitness.
Unveiled seeing makes one of that; mantra-nearness visible to graced.
Blazing right hand burns head-heart-navel bonds.
Gentle left fattens with pure principle; then bow.
Outside offering; sipping.
Meal eaten; oneness with disciple; awakened stay.
Inauspicious dreams unexplained.
Unexplained dreams breed fear; weapon-expiation only.
Breath-course entry; six places touched; eight refinements each; rest; descend.
48 refinements + Rudra-part = samayin.
Worshippable mantra bestowed with flowers.
Rules laid down.
Devotion to guru/scripture/God; aversion to opponents; reverence to kin and fellow-initiates.
No loathing-cause toward barren women.
Names unspoken outside worship-time.
Guru-enjoyed things not to be enjoyed.
No worldly play near the guru.
No excellence-thought elsewhere.
Guru alone everywhere.
No śākinī-words on occasionals.
Festival days worshipped.
No company with the lower-seeing.
No former-birth thought in this teaching.
Worship as able for the guru's circle.
Abandon even a guru-turned-apostate with his clan.
No excellence-thought even then.
No mixing with sects; mere as-able worship.
Doubts abandoned.
No birth-made last-first fancy in the wheel.
No abode higher than the body.
Constant mantra-heart; wealth-to-body dakṣiṇā; sating of priors and poor.
Image-wheel sated by future rule.
Thus samayin: ahnika seal.
Entitled to practice/study; occasionals need the guru.
Samayin rule: final seal.

rasa.dominant: vidhi-prīti (love of ordinance) with adbhuta at threshold moments
rasa.justification: The ahnika legislates the whole outer rite step by step and each step lands as trust; wonder breaks through at the Mālinī etymology (u7), the trident-lotus ascent (u33-34), and the glance that makes one of that (u68).

sections.KEY TERMS: samayin (bound disciple: 48 saṃskāras + Rudra-part); adhivāsa (preparation: disciple sharpened, God turned, guru taking); Mālinī (chief Śākta form; seed-womb collision; ra-la oneness); mālinī/sabdarāśi mantras (Śakti-first, foot-to-head for release); arghapātra-nyāsa (vessel shows every factor Lord); dik (no separate principle; Bhairava faces; shadow-overstepping centrality; sūrya = jñānaśakti); spandakalā (first throb-digit form); śūlābja (trident-lotus to Sadāśiva-corpse); antar-yāga definitions (offering/meditation/murmur/oblation); khecarī verses (sequence abandoned; faring-resting-nectar); cakrapūjā (foot-seat, head-seat); pūrṇāhuti (even-footed nectar-stream vauṣaḍ); netra-bandha (blindfold flower-cast; unveiled one-making); śaktipāta (visible mantra-nearness); prāṇakrama entry (six places × eight refinements); samaya code (devotion, aversion, reverence, silence, equality, body-supreme, mantra-heart); dakṣiṇā (wealth-to-body; priors and poor sated).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 13 completes the samayin arc (a12 snāna assumed before it; a14–a16 putraka/special dīkṣās follow): the beginner's binding path before power-descent rites. Kin: a12 (bathing), a20 (nitya/naimittika worship), a22 (Kaula close). Witnesses: OccultGuide full ahnika, vishvasa English rendering — parallels, not sources.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) place doctrine — gladness the only mark, meditated-identity the cause, seats as aids, entered powers and solitude-concentration; (2) nyāsa — general placing hands-then-body, two mantras with Śakti-first and release/enjoyment order, Mālinī unfolded (form, name, power over broken/stained), vessel nyāsa showing every-factor-Lord with becoming-Lord by seeing; (3) entry — retinue, door, unguarded-outside relocation, weapon-flower clearing, kindled-gaze survey, north-facing burning, direction principle; (4) directions — middle light, quarters by light-relations, Bhairava faces, no-separate-principle, shadow-overstepping centrality, sun-as-knowledge-power, triad-unification per gurus; (5) throne — I-feeling burning, waveless abode, first-digit form, wheel-placing with powers chief, seat-ness reasons, six states, sixfold seal, fullness as Bhairavī-being with objection answered, Lord-made seeing; (6) trident-lotus — body-breath-mind placing, root-to-Sadāśiva ascent, inner worship definitions, spark-retinue, khecarī verses, inner-sufficiency with outer-need; (7) adhivāsa — preparation list, daily rite, three adhivāsa meanings, in-house swelling, assembly, ground-taking, jar-making, second vessel, guardians, handing, guru's jar, procession, attentiveness, 'bho' oneness, placing, both worshipped, center worship; (8) fire and oblation — fire-pit with heart-fire unity, mantra-sating, refining rites, full-oblation posture, caru sharing, tooth-stick, weapon oblation; (9) disciple — blindfold flower-cast, unveiled one-making with visible nearness, bond-burning right hand, gentle left with bowing, outer offering with sipping, oneness-stay, dream silence, weapon-expiation; (10) entry — breath-course six-place touching, eight refinements each, rest, descend, 48 + Rudra-part = samayin, mantra bestowal; (11) samaya code — devotion/aversion/reverence, name-silence, no play, no mixing, no birth-thought, hospitality, apostate-abandoning, sect-distance, doubt-abandoning, wheel-equality, body-supreme, mantra-heart; (12) dakṣiṇā and close — wealth-to-body giving, priors/poor sating, image-wheel, entitlement with guru-needed occasionals, final seal.
sections.BOUNDARY: Four genuine L0 forks adjudicated (uktāv locative; prāgra foremost; viśūla trident; pūga betel-nut). Anomalous print forms kept with flags: śākinī-words (u86), apostate-abandoning junction (u91), amblīkaraṇam (u43), mukhyādikādi lists (u47), tadupari series (u75), samaya-code compounds (u79). 'Bho' oneness and three-syllabled name recorded, not derived. Rival school details none here. OccultGuide/vishvasa kept as witness-parallels only.
